# Achievable

> > Achievable provides adaptive exam prep courses using memory science for standardized tests including ACT, GRE, MCAT, FINRA securities exams, insurance licensing, IT certifications like CCNA, and college admissions tests.

Achievable offers comprehensive test preparation with adaptive learning technology, practice exams, and study resources across academic, professional licensing, and certification exams. The platform also maintains a directory of ACT tutors and provides course comparison guides to help students choose the right prep materials.

## Key Topics

- Achievable test prep platform
- ACT exam preparation
- FINRA securities licensing (Series 65, Series 10)
- GRE and MCAT standardized tests
- Insurance licensing (Property & Casualty)
- IT certifications (CCNA, CompTIA Network+)
- Classic Learning Test (CLT)
- ASVAB military entrance exam
- PTCE pharmacy technician certification
- AP U.S. Government exam
- Adaptive learning technology
- Memory science study methods
- Practice exams and study resources
- Tutor directory services
- Course comparison guides
